column1: #   source term <TAB> approved target <TAB> bad variants (; separated) <TAB> mode
# mode: repair (default, post-edit) | inject (put the term into the source) | both
# Repair is safe: it only touches renderings you already know are wrong.
# Inject is for names and product words that must appear verbatim
# ("Bereitstellungsplan"), and it can cost a grammatical gender elsewhere —
# which is why it is opt-in per term.
